packet: jacket_material_m002 (Codex brief at 68e1524), material only on the held f002 geometry

jacket_m002_albedo.png.contents: base colour of jacket shell, pockets and trim in one atlas; background outside the islands = front-panel colour sRGB 221, 166, 46

jacket_m002_roughness.png.colour_space: linear (Non-Color), same value in R, G and B
jacket_m002_roughness.png.range: shell 0.861 to 0.896 (0.88 plus or minus 0.025 low-frequency noise), trim 0.80, background 0.88

textures.in_the_glb: The exporter embeds the albedo PNG byte-identical (same sha256). It re-packs roughness into a glTF metallicRoughness image (sha256 b0203bcc...): G = roughness, R and B = 255; B (metallic) has no effect because metallicFactor is 0.

uv: One UV set M002_UV (TEXCOORD_0) shared by the three parts, all inside 0..1, no island pixel shared by two parts. The f002 UV layers UVMap and SurfaceUV (overlapping, outside 0..1, never used by a texture) are removed in the candidate.

materials_blender.unchanged_from_f002: metallic, specular, specular tint, sheen, clearcoat, IOR, double-sided; neck layer SCULPT_MAT_SCARF (collar v004) stays linear 0.200, 0.112, 0.058, roughness 0.9

colour_plan_linear.lower_band: full below z 0.53, fading out by z 0.60 (rest pose, metres); not on sleeves
colour_plan_linear.dye_noise: 3D value noise in rest-pose world space, scales 0.09 and 0.045 m, seed 20261127; value multiplier 1 + 0.06 n, green multiplier 1 + 0.05 n (shell, pockets); trim value 1 + 0.03 n
colour_plan_linear.panel_blends: sleeves by arm-bone skin weight (smoothstep 0.35 to 0.75); back by distance behind the torso's mid-depth at that height (smoothstep -15 to +35 mm), so the side transitions are about 5 cm wide
colour_plan_linear.not_used: no occlusion, curvature, cavity, directional light, seam lines, stitching, weave or grunge

godot_proposal_not_tested.note: Blender values do not map one-to-one through glTF. Codex owns the Godot import, shader and lighting; these are starting points only.
godot_proposal_not_tested.albedo_texture: jacket_m002_albedo (sRGB, as Godot treats albedo by default); albedo_color white
godot_proposal_not_tested.roughness: roughness_texture = the GLB metallicRoughness image, roughness_texture_channel = GREEN, roughness = 1.0 (multiplier)
godot_proposal_not_tested.specular: Blender specular 0.2 exports as KHR_materials_specular specularColorFactor 0.474 and KHR_materials_ior 1.45, unchanged from f002. If the Godot importer ignores these, StandardMaterial3D metallic_specular stays 0.5; a lower value (about 0.3) would be the cloth-side choice if the jacket reads glossy, to be judged under the native lights.
godot_proposal_not_tested.vertex_colour: COLOR_0 on shell and trim is all white, exactly as in f002; using it as albedo changes nothing
godot_proposal_not_tested.diagnosis: render the jacket with an unshaded material and compare with jacket_material_m002_texture_preview.png
